text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thirty Serb houses in the Drvar region were set on fire by local Croats on Sunday afternoon, the newspaper reported.

- Former commander of U.N. forces in Bosnia, French General Jean Cot, said in an interview that NATO forces should have come to Bosnia earlier but were prevented by U.S. who did not want to risk their soldiers' lives.

- Association of Bosnia's trade unions held conference in Sarajevo with international guests over the weekend. Aiming to unite the country's trade unions, the conference fell short of because Serb representatives failed to attend the meeting in Sarajevo. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
